contexts.text: Faith from love is like the light of the sun in the time of spring... AC 2231:3. AC 2388:2. DFaith 32:end.
Those in mutual love, in Heaven, continually advance to the springtime of their youth. HH 414.
As in the time of spring, when all things vegetate...
All things (there) appear in their most beautiful spring and flower.
Under Peace, see this reference. AC 5052. AC 5662:2.
A vernal heat from the Word.
The first age of the Church is compared to the spring, when all things bloom.
In proportion as the Angels are in love, charity, and the derivative faith, they are in an aura of vernal light and heat.
After temptations, the state is like one or spring, which succeeds one of winter.
As the eye is affected with the flowers in gardens and meadows in the time of spring.
The sun then inflows with heat (also), as happens in the time of spring and summer...
This is the morning, or spring, of Spirits.
The light in Heaven is like the vernal light, to which heat is united...
To these states correspond the spring times and summer times on earth.
(In the Sixth Earth) there is perpetual springtime and summer-time, because the year is so short... whence the ground is verdant continuously.
Spring and morning are turned into the idea of a state of love and wisdom such as exists in the Angels' first state.
Under Dawn, see this reference.
(Such) live there in a vernal temperateness.
(Spring = the first time of the Church.)
When the heat and light in the Heavens make a one, it is like springtime with the Angels.
Hence the Angels have perpetual spring. DLW 105:2. ISB 4:2.
There then breathed a vernal heat from Heaven. CL 137.

The reason why, when we approached, there breathed on thee as it were a vernal heat, is that in our Heaven conjugial love and that heat act as a one... In Heaven, where there is vernal heat, there is love truly conjugial; for no where else is there what is vernal than where heat and light are united in equal proportions.

Our Sun remains at a middle altitude; and hence it is that the heat and light which proceed from it make perpetual spring; and that a perpetual Vernal breathes into those with whom love is united with wisdom in equal proportions... Hence, also, are the germinations on your Earth, and the pairing of your birds and animals in the times of spring; for the vernal heat opens their interiors even to their inmosts, which are called their souls, and affects them, and implants its Conjugial in them... But with men there is a perpetual influx of vernal heat from the Lord, and therefore they can be deliciated in marriage at all times, even in the middle of winter; for males have been created receptions of wisdom... and females of love of the male's wisdom; and hence it is that as we approached there breathed on thee a vernal heat attended with a sweet odour, like that from the first growths in gardens and fields.
These things are from the vernal temperateness of (natural) light and heat; but those are from the vernal temperateness of (spiritual) light and heat.
Love truly conjugial is exactly like the vernal heat, from the influx of which all things aspire to germinations and fructifications; nor is there any other heat in that Heaven.
Regeneration is represented by the flowering of all things in the time of spring.
In the other life they do not know what spring, summer, autumn, and winter are.
Occurs. AE 701:end.
It is the time of spring for man when he enters Heaven, which takes place when his Internal is opened: previous to this it is the winter time with him.
Then the man is like a garden in the time of spring, when heat is united to light...
